takeaways: CMBS distress hit 11.2% in October with 93% of new distress tied to maturities, while Bushburg's sub-$400M 60 Wall deal (vs $1.04B in 2017) shows how deep office resets are running.

Brookdale's occupancy rose 130 bps to 83.1% yet it cut guidance and the stock fell ~17%, while Janus Living doubled to 74 properties at about $350K/unit, so capital is rewarding acquirers over operators.
Post-midterm data-center moratoria and a $2.5T Nasdaq drop put AI-linked CRE and structured financing on watch.

items.headline: Bushburg in contract to buy 60 Wall Street for under $400M (~$250/sf) for resi conversion
items.summary: GIC and Rithm's Elecor are selling the 1.6M sf, 55-story tower at roughly a 60% discount to GIC's 2017 $1.04B valuation ($640/sf). Conversion rents at nearby 80 Pine exceed $100/sf, so distressed office-to-resi basis is clearing (via The Promote).

items.headline: CMBS distress rate hits 11.2% in October as $4.5B newly distressed, 93% tied to maturities
items.summary: CRED iQ: office distress is 16.4% (44% of all distressed debt), Chicago 23.5%, Philadelphia 23.0%, and 2021-22 CRE CLOs 34.8%. The next distress wave looks debt-driven rather than demand-driven, with well-occupied assets like 2400 Market St (99.5% occupied) in special servicing.

items.headline: Brookdale Q3: occupancy 83.1% (+130 bps) but guidance cut and stock falls ~17%
items.summary: Adjusted EBITDA rose 12% to $124.3M and RevPAR grew 7.5%, but full-year EBITDA guidance fell to $495-502M from $502-516M on marketing spend and occupancy carryover. Brookdale bought 17 leased communities for $157.4M and agreed to buy 30 more for $290M.

items.headline: Janus Living doubles portfolio to 74 properties on $2.9B of 2026 acquisitions
items.summary: Average cost is about $350K per unit at 86-87% occupancy, and 80% of deals involve no operator change. Janus has 13 operators, a $1.25B credit facility, $82M under contract for Q4, and Q3 FFO up 46% to 25 cents per share.

items.headline: Data-center moratoria spread after midterms: 40+ local measures, Texas calls for freeze
items.summary: All but one restrictive ballot measure passed; about 13 GW of Texas capacity is exposed, with hundreds of billions in financing at risk (via The Promote).

items.headline: Midterm selloff erases $2.5T from Nasdaq in a day, pushing it into correction
items.summary: Hedge funds dumped positions and systematic trades amplified losses on fears Democratic wins hit AI and data centers. A WSJ columnist argues moratoria may be bargaining tools (via WSJ 10-Point).

items.headline: Hudson Pacific posts $218M Q3 loss on office haircuts; Weil Gotshal rent excluded from guidance
items.summary: Losses came from sales in Seattle, San Jose and SF plus impairments after a $572M loss in 2025 (via The Promote).

items.headline: Arbor Realty down 73% YTD and suspends dividend; Alexandria selling life-science assets
items.summary: Multifamily lender stress and REIT asset sales continue; TPG is raising $5B and BXMT has its own issues (via The Promote).

items.headline: American Healthcare REIT buys two California senior communities for $197M
items.summary: The 545-unit Avella at Roseville ($94.1M) and Avella at Almaden ($102.8M) came from an Affinius/Alliance JV. Senior housing sales reached about $33.3B over 12 months, up 83%, and occupancy rose for a 20th straight quarter to 89.9% (Q2 NIC MAP).

items.headline: Dwindling pay drives exits from Blackstone's marquee real-estate team
items.summary: Nearly a third of senior managing directors have left in three years as fund returns slump, with no near-term fix while rates stay high (via WSJ 10-Point).

items.headline: 20-somethings ditch entry-level jobs to become their own bosses
items.summary: At least 23% of Americans aged 18-34 ran a business or side hustle last year, up from 19% in 2021 (Babson), with AI helping bypass corporate ladders (via WSJ 10-Point).

items.headline: How a talent war doomed the traditional law firm, per Weil Gotshal's collapse
items.summary: Rainmakers command $20-30M and compensation changes let firms raid each other, driving record partner turnover (via WSJ 10-Point).

items.headline: Nvidia board probes CEO's disclosed affair tied to suspected Chinese operative
items.summary: The $4T company's board is investigating while expressing confidence in Jensen Huang (via WSJ 10-Point).

items.headline: Prager hit with $236M Chicago foreclosure suit; Blackstone funds $310M Nashville bridge
items.summary: A Kansas credit union says Shaya Prager's Opal owes $236M on 35 West Wacker, while Blackstone provided a bridge on a Nashville tower (via The Promote).

items.headline: Blackstone's Safe Harbor to buy MarineMax for $1.5B cash at $53/share, a 96% premium
items.summary: The all-cash deal (announced Aug 10) follows a competitive strategic review and is expected to close before year-end, pending shareholder and regulatory approval. MarineMax has ~70 dealerships and 65 marina/storage sites, and fiscal Q3 revenue fell 7% to $611.3M even as gross margin rose to 35.7%. Infrastructure capital is paying up for recurring-revenue marinas while boat retail stays weak.

items.headline: BizBuySell Q3: 2,132 small businesses sold, median price $350K (+17% YoY)
items.summary: Closed deals were down 7% YoY, but median cash flow rose 5% to $156K. Deals above $1M averaged 3.73x cash flow and sold at 100.8% of ask, versus 2.30x and 93.6% below $1M. Service businesses were 47% of deals; restaurants fell 23%. New SBA rules took effect Oct 1.

items.headline: Acquisition entrepreneurship goes mainstream as owners retire
items.summary: A 2026 JPMorgan Chase survey found 40% of small business owners plan to retire within a decade, and about 70% have no formal or only early succession plans. Search funds, SBA loans and personal capital are financing buyers, with HVAC, accounting, home services and B2B services the common targets. Founder dependency is the key diligence risk (Forbes, May 2026).

items.headline: U.S. is the last true profit engine for the world's carmakers
items.summary: VW is weighing its first U.S. pickup in 40 years as record sticker prices draw global automakers (via WSJ 10-Point).

items.headline: Firefly Aerospace jumps 37% on $1.3B AST SpaceMobile engine deal
items.summary: The stock had been down nearly a third year to date (via WSJ 10-Point).

items.headline: Ex-Vornado leasing exec gets 11 years for $9.5M commission fraud
items.summary: Jared Solomon ran a double-ended commission scheme; a reminder on controls in leasing compensation (via The Promote).

items.headline: Wealthy parents build bowling alleys and spas to lure grown kids home
items.summary: Spending runs from hundreds of thousands to millions on amenities, with mixed results (via WSJ 10-Point).

items.headline: The surprising rise of teen pilots
items.summary: Young people are getting early starts in aviation careers (via WSJ 10-Point).
